title: Wordiv8
description: A live quiz platform built for learning together, with presenter and player UIs. Leverages Gemini to generate questions on a requested topic. Each player can only answer in 1 word and the answers are shown on the presenter screen as a word cloud. The more answers a word gets, the bigger the word is on the screen, which shows the current consensus of the answers to everyone. The questions are evaluated at the end by Gemini, calculating each player's score for a leaderboard.

title: Impression
description: A professional profile rating platform. Rate anonymous profiles and get feedback on your professional presentation. Ratings come from the community, professionals, and AI. Interactions on the website cost quotas, which are gained through rating other profiles. Profile Ratings are based on 3 criteria chosen by AI for a given role that is chosen upon creating a profile. Professionals approved by the admin can add comments to their ratings.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A personal portfolio website built on Next.js. Leveraged component libraries from AceternityUI, React Bits, and MagicUI.

title: Booktiv8
description: A reading-list website for finding books, store book notes, and summarize books. Books are taken from OpenLibrary using their publicly available API, allowing searches and direct downloads. Book summaries are generated by Google Gemini

title: HacktivTube
description: A social media platform for posting images. Users can follow other users, like and comment posts. UI design is inspired by Youtube.

title: Mandalika Music
description: A music e-commerce website built on Next.js. A rebuilt copy from the website mandalikamusic.com.
